answer: For a rating of gale damage to a copper sculpture in the grove, the server verifies election-bound signatures against a frozen roster, accepts one rating per key and rejects invalid or repeat submissions. It discards the 10 highest and 10 lowest ratings, then averages the rest. If all honest ratings are lower, one extreme high rating survives only with 11 such submissions, potentially requiring recruitment. Fake roster entries and shared keys remain risks.
